reviews.text: Ok so I brought this gloss because I heard from a TikTok video that it’s long lasting!! and it’s exactly what it is! I love the shade, it stays perfectly and really is long lasting, highly recommend. Just know that if you want it to be glossy you should apply another gloss on top of it, cause it’s not really glossy without it, the packaging is so cute as well. thank you (˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶)💕
reviews.zh: 好啦，我買咗呢支 gloss 係因為喺 TikTok 見到有人話佢超持久！！用落真係同講嘅一樣！我好鍾意呢個色號，貼服又真係好持久，極推薦。不過要留意，如果你想佢有光澤感，就要再疊多一層 gloss 上去，因為單用嘅話光澤感唔算強。包裝都好得意。多謝 (˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶)💕

reviews.text: It's a good lip tint, gives a nice glow and its gives a bit of moist, the color stays for a long time. The reasons it isn't 5 stars are 2: 1. The pigments are too strong IMO, so it's don't use it on daily basis. I wanted something more natural looking. When i apply on the lips the color is darker than the one shown in the add. 2. It's not really hydrating and when my lips are dry I won't apply it.
reviews.zh: 支唇液唔錯，有靚光澤又會有少少水潤感，顏色都好持久。扣起一粒星嘅原因有兩個：1. 我自己覺得色素太強，唔適合日日用。我想要自然啲嘅效果，而且我搽上嘴唇之後嘅顏色比起廣告上面顯示嘅深。2. 保濕度真係唔夠，嘴唇乾嘅話我唔會用。

reviews.text:
I LOVE THIS TINT SO MUCH!! my first time ever using peripera tints by the way!! on the first picture it's when i just applied after 5 minutes, and second picture it's after 6-7 hours of wear after eating and drinking a lot, no reapplication. i live in dry climate and have a very dry skin and lips, especially nowadays because of the season transition, yet this tint doesn't look too bad on my lips after applying and after hours of wear!! 
the color doesn't look exactly the way as shown on the pictures online, but it doesn't bother me personally ^^
definitely don't regret buying this tint <3
reviews.zh:
我勁鍾意呢支唇液！！順帶一提，係我第一次用 peripera 嘅唇液！！第一張相係我搽完五分鐘之後嘅狀態，第二張係經過食嘢飲水，六至七個鐘之後冇補過色嘅狀態。我住喺好乾燥嘅地方，皮膚同嘴唇都超乾，特別而家正值季節轉換，但係呢支唇液無論係啱啱搽定係用咗幾個鐘之後，喺我嘴唇上面嘅效果都唔算差！！
顏色同網上面嘅相有少少唔同，但係對我嚟講冇影響 ^^
完全唔後悔買咗呢支唇液 <3

reviews.text:
I cannot have enough of these liptints!
I started with the Pink Youth! A light cool color with a darker stain due to my own lip color
The rose in mind! A lot warmer and darker on my lips than I expected but still such a pretty color!
Cherry so what! A bright warmer pink color that left a stain that lasted even after a toothbrush session!
The cooling pink! Such pretty lucky clover packaging and the color! Lighter and cooler pink toned than Pink Youth, it was the one to get my lips which are darker to appear MLBB in a non-in your face way! Truly what I wanted!
Then Pink! Such pretty packaging with the puppy and the bunny! Similar in color to rose in mind except lighter and leaves a cool pink stain!

All these left lasting stains and so pretty! I never used any lipliners or foundation on my lips so they would appear darker than in the photos. Still the colors were very pretty regardless! Can’t wait for Peripera to release more seasonal packaging cool tone shades!!!
reviews.zh:
我點都嫌唔夠多呢啲唇液！
我第一支係 Pink Youth！淺淺嘅冷色調，但係因為我本身嘅唇色比較深，所以留色會深啲
然後係 rose in mind！比我預期更加暖同更加深色喺我嘴唇上面，但係依然好靚！
Cherry so what！係好鮮明嘅暖粉紅色，留色勁持久，連用牙刷擦完都仲有！
The cooling pink！包裝係好靚嘅幸運草，顏色都好正！比起 Pink Youth 更加淺更加冷調嘅粉紅，對於我呢種唇色深嘅人，佢可以做到一個低調嘅 MLBB 效果！真係我想要嘅嘢！
然後係 Pink！小狗同小兔嘅包裝好得意！顏色同 rose in mind 差唔多，只係淺少少，留低嘅係冷調粉紅色！

每支嘅留色都好持久又靚！我從來唔用唇線筆或者粉底去遮我嘅嘴唇，所以相入面睇起嚟會深過實際。不過顏色真係好靚！等不及 Peripera 出多啲有季節感包裝嘅冷調色！！！

reviews.text: I didn’t realise that the gloss gift meant the clear gloss I think the type option plus choosing the photo was confusing so I actually got my second preference for the colour nude area. This colour does not show up on my lips at all once you apply and spread it on your lips so if you don’t have pale lips might not work out for you. The clear loss has a slight smell I don’t like but otherwise the clear gloss and nude area basically looked the same on my lips which would be kinda like MLBB 😂
reviews.zh: 我冇意識到 gloss gift 係指 clear gloss，揀類型加揀相呢個組合有啲混亂，所以最後我只係攞到我第二選擇嘅 nude area 顏色。呢個色搽上嘴唇再推開之後基本上完全睇唔到，如果你唔係淺唇嘅話可能未必啱你用。clear gloss 有少少味道我唔太鍾意，但除此之外 clear gloss 同 nude area 喺我嘴唇上面基本上望落一樣，差唔多係 MLBB 😂

reviews.text:
this lip tint color is amazing for darker skin tones! the pigmentation for it is really nice! i have two tone lips so i was a bit surprised to see that the color can still be seen on my top lip (it isn’t has much as my bottom lip but you can still see it a bit)
i also love the glossy look it has when you first put it on 
the one downside i will say is that it can be drying and the cracks in your lips will be shown so to combat that you’ll have to reapply for the hydration instead of doing that i suggest moisturize your lips with some lip balm or vaseline before application 
other then that this lip tint is amazing will purchase from this brand and color again!!
reviews.zh:
呢支唇液嘅顏色對深色肌膚嚟講真係超靚！顯色度好好！我本身係雙色唇，所以上唇仲可以見到顏色令我幾驚喜（雖然無下唇咁深色，但係都仲睇到少少）
我亦都好鍾意啱啱搽上去嗰陣嘅光澤感
唯一嘅缺點係佢會比較乾，嘴唇有嘅乾紋都會現形，所以如果想解決嘅話你需要補搽多幾次去保濕，但我建議唔好咁做，改為喺上唇之前先用潤唇膏或者凡士林打底會比較好
除此之外，呢支唇液真係好正，會再回購呢個品牌同呢個顏色！！

reviews.text: I bought the shade 01 first and liked it so much that I bought another in shade 04. The pink youth may seem like a bright baby/neon pink, but it settles on your lips and matches with your lip color. It’s glossy but not overwhelmingly so that it makes you look like you ate a bunch of fries. It’s not sticky and you can lightly dab away the glossiness with a tissue if you prefer matte lip products or if you’re wearing it under a mask. I also have thin small lips and this does help make my lips look more plump. It has a sweet scent, something like brown sugar and it doesn’t bother me at all. You can’t really smell anything after you’ve applied it.
reviews.zh: 我先買咗 01 色號，鍾意到即刻再買咗支 04 色號。Pink Youth 望落好似係鮮明嘅 baby pink 或者 neon pink，但係佢會慢慢貼服返你嘅唇色，搽上去好好配合。佢有光澤感但又唔會去到好誇張，搞到你塊面望落好似食完一堆薯條咁。佢唔黐立立，如果你鍾意霧面唇妝或者戴住口罩嘅話，可以用紙巾輕輕印走光澤。我嘅嘴唇比較薄細，用咗呢支之後望落真係豐滿返啲。佢有種甜味，好似黑糖咁，對我嚟講完全冇問題。搽完之後基本上就聞唔到任何味道。

reviews.text: 유투버들화면이랑 진짜다르네여..색이 엄청탁하고 꾸덕한데 희안하게 바르면 시간지날수록 광이 올라오긴하네요 입숙색이약간잇는저한텐 진짜 티도안남....
reviews.zh: 同 YouTuber 螢幕上面睇到嘅真係完全唔同……顏色好濁好厚身，但係神奇嘅係搽上去之後，時間耐咗光澤會慢慢出返。對我呢種本身有少許唇色嘅人嚟講，真係完全唔顯色……

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
